Investigation revealed prior low‑severity scanning activity from internal IP 10.0.1.1. Rule deleted after business‑hour approval.

timeline.description: Alert generated: firewall_rule_anomaly – rule ALLOW-LEGACY-RDP allows inbound RDP from any source to 10.0.2.0/24.
IOC lookup via T2_ids_cmdb for source IP 10.0.1.1 returned low‑severity Nmap scan alert (IDS-2026-03200) on host WS-IT-101.
SIEM search (T6_siem_search) for inbound RDP events over past 30 days returned 23 hits, including external scan from 192.168.1.100 and internal authentication from WS-IT-101.
Containment: higher‑priority deny rule created to block inbound TCP 3389 to DMZ pending rule removal.
Remediation: ALLOW-LEGACY-RDP rule deleted (T9_firewall delete_rule) after business‑hour window opened.
Post‑remediation verification: traffic to 10.0.2.0/24 on port 3389 confirmed blocked; no further alerts.
Incident closure and after‑action report generation.
